company.shortDescription: Gainz is an innovative crowdfunding platform designed to streamline the processes of fundraising and investment.
company.description:
Transforming working capital financing in MENA—helping SMEs secure funding in under 7 days while offering lucrative returns to investors.

Gainz connects retail investors, and institutions with vetted debt financing opportunities, lowering barriers to entry, enabling businesses to scale-hassle-free, and ensuring secondary exit options.

Fast funding for businesses. High-yield returns for investors. Because capital should work smarter, not harder.

insights.statement: The latest disclosed Debt Financing round raised $4,000,000, or 57.14% of reported total funding.

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $15,532,304 to $15,532,304, a 1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
